sides.text: Amazon S3

Object storage with 11 nines durability
unlimited capacity
objects up to 5 TB

more.text: Single PUT up to 5 GB; use multipart upload above 100 MB (required above 5 GB).

sides.text: S3 performance
3,500 write and 5,500 read requests per second per prefix; parallelize across prefixes

more.text: Byte-range fetches and multipart uploads improve throughput.

sides.head: Example
sides.text: An application needs 20,000 GET requests per second against one bucket. How?

more.head: Answer
more.text: Spread objects across at least four prefixes
more.extra: Each prefix supports 5,500 GETs per second

sides.text: S3 Transfer Acceleration
Uses CloudFront edge locations to speed uploads over long distances
S3 consistency
Strong read-after-write consistency for all operations
S3 storage classes

Standard
Intelligent-Tiering
Standard-IA
One Zone-IA
Glacier Instant Retrieval
Glacier Flexible Retrieval
Glacier Deep Archive

more.text: Use lifecycle rules to move data between them.

sides.text: Amazon EBS
Block storage for EC2, replicated within one AZ; attach to one instance (Multi-Attach for io1/io2)

more.text: Snapshots to S3; encryption with KMS.

sides.text: EBS volume types
gp3/gp2 general SSD, io2/io1 Provisioned IOPS SSD, st1 throughput HDD, sc1 cold HDD

more.text: HDD volumes cannot be boot volumes.

sides.text: gp3 vs gp2
gp3: 3,000 IOPS and 125 MB/s baseline, scale IOPS and throughput independently, up to 16,000 IOPS. gp2: 3 IOPS per GiB, burst credits

sides.head: Example
sides.text: A workload needs 12,000 IOPS on a 100 GiB volume at the lowest cost

more.head: Answer
more.extra: gp2 would need 4,000 GiB to reach 12,000 IOPS (3 per GiB)

sides.text: Provisioned IOPS (io2)
For latency-sensitive databases: up to 64,000 IOPS (256,000 on io2 Block Express), Multi-Attach, 99.999% durability
Instance store
Physically attached ephemeral storage with very high IOPS; data is lost when the instance stops

more.text: Good for caches and scratch data.

sides.text: Amazon EFS
Managed NFS for Linux, regional and elastic, shared by thousands of instances across AZs

more.text: Performance: General Purpose or Max I/O. Throughput: Elastic, Provisioned, or Bursting.

sides.head: Example
sides.text: Many Linux web servers across AZs must share files
Amazon FSx
FSx for Windows File Server (SMB, AD), Lustre (HPC, S3-linked), NetApp ONTAP (multi-protocol), OpenZFS

sides.head: Example
sides.text: A Windows application needs SMB shares with Active Directory

more.head: Answer
more.text: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server

sides.text: AWS Storage Gateway
Hybrid access to AWS storage: File Gateway (NFS/SMB to S3), Volume Gateway (iSCSI, cached or stored), Tape Gateway (virtual tapes)

sides.head: Example
sides.text: Present S3 as an NFS share to on-premises applications with local caching
Choosing storage
Object: S3. Block: EBS for one instance. Shared POSIX file: EFS. Windows SMB: FSx. HPC: FSx for Lustre
EC2 instance families

M general
C compute optimized
R/X memory optimized
I/D storage optimized
G/P accelerated (GPU)
T burstable
Burstable instances (T)
Baseline CPU with credits to burst; unlimited mode can burst beyond credits for a charge
Placement groups
Cluster: low latency in one AZ. Spread: separate hardware (max 7 per AZ). Partition: groups on different racks for large distributed systems

sides.head: Example
sides.text: A tightly coupled HPC job needs the lowest node-to-node latency

more.head: Answer
more.extra: Instances sit close together in one AZ

sides.text: EC2 enhanced networking and EFA
ENA gives high bandwidth; Elastic Fabric Adapter adds OS-bypass for HPC and ML
AWS Batch
Run batch jobs at any scale; provisions compute and queues jobs
Amazon EMR
Managed Hadoop, Spark, and Hive for big data processing; use Spot for task nodes
Lambda memory and CPU
CPU power scales with configured memory (128 MB to 10,240 MB)

more.text: Raise memory to speed CPU-bound functions.

sides.text: Containers and orchestration
ECS and EKS orchestrate containers; Fargate removes server management
EC2 Auto Scaling metrics
CPU, network, ALB request count per target, SQS queue depth per instance, custom CloudWatch metrics

AWS Outposts
Wavelength
Local Zones
Outposts: AWS hardware on-premises. Wavelength: compute in 5G networks. Local Zones: infrastructure near large cities
Decoupling for independent scaling
Queue between web and worker tiers so each scales on its own metric
AWS Elastic Beanstalk and App Runner
Beanstalk deploys app code onto managed EC2; App Runner deploys containers or source with minimal configuration
Choosing a database
Relational: RDS/Aurora. Key-value at scale: DynamoDB. In-memory: ElastiCache/MemoryDB. Analytics: Redshift. Graph: Neptune. Documents: DocumentDB. Time series: Timestream. Cassandra: Keyspaces
Amazon RDS
Managed MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Oracle, SQL Server, and Db2; automated backups, patching, Multi-AZ

more.text: Up to 5 read replicas (15 for Aurora).

sides.text: Amazon Aurora
MySQL and PostgreSQL compatible, up to 5× MySQL performance, storage auto-scales to 128 TiB, 15 replicas

more.text: Aurora Serverless v2 scales capacity automatically.

sides.text: Aurora Global Database
Cross-Region replication with typically under one second lag and fast regional failover
Amazon DynamoDB
Serverless key-value and document database with single-digit millisecond latency

more.text: Partition key (and optional sort key); GSIs and LSIs for other access patterns.

sides.head: Example
sides.text: Sudden unpredictable traffic spikes with no capacity planning wanted
DynamoDB capacity modes
On-demand: pay per request, unpredictable traffic. Provisioned: set RCUs and WCUs, with auto scaling

more.text: Reserved capacity discounts steady provisioned load.

sides.text: DynamoDB capacity units
1 RCU = one strongly consistent read per second up to 4 KB (two eventually consistent). 1 WCU = one write per second up to 1 KB

more.text: Transactional reads cost 2 RCUs and writes 2 WCUs.

sides.head: Example
sides.text: Item size 3 KB, 50 writes per second. WCUs?

In-memory cache for DynamoDB with microsecond reads and no application changes beyond the client

more.head: Answer
more.extra: A write-through cache in front of DynamoDB

Database migration
DMS migrates data with minimal downtime; SCT converts schemas for heterogeneous migrations (Oracle to Aurora)

more.text: Homogeneous: same engine; heterogeneous: different engines.

sides.head: Example
sides.text: Migrate Oracle to Aurora PostgreSQL with minimal downtime

more.head: Answer
more.text: DMS plus the Schema Conversion Tool

sides.text: Read replicas and caching
Read replicas scale reads at the database; caches offload hot reads before the database

more.text: Choose caches for repeated identical queries.

sides.text: Database capacity planning
Choose instance class, storage type (gp3 vs Provisioned IOPS), connections, and read/write ratio
VPC CIDR and subnets
A VPC CIDR is /16 to /28; AWS reserves 5 addresses in every subnet

more.text: Plan non-overlapping ranges for peering and VPNs.

sides.text: VPC peering

Private routing between two VPCs
not transitive
no overlapping CIDRs
AWS Transit Gateway
Regional hub connecting many VPCs and on-premises networks; supports transitive routing

more.text: Peering other Transit Gateways links Regions.

sides.head: Example
sides.text: Connect 50 VPCs and on-premises with simple routing
Site-to-Site VPN

Encrypted IPsec tunnels between on-premises and a VPC
two tunnels per connection for redundancy
about 1.25 Gbps per tunnel
AWS Direct Connect
Dedicated private link (1, 10, or 100 Gbps) or hosted connection; consistent latency and lower data transfer costs

more.text: Setup takes weeks; use a VPN as backup.

sides.head: Example
sides.text: Consistent low-latency private link to AWS for steady heavy traffic
Direct Connect gateway
Connects one Direct Connect to many VPCs across Regions
Amazon CloudFront vs Global Accelerator
CloudFront caches HTTP content at the edge. Global Accelerator gives static anycast IPs and routes TCP/UDP over the AWS backbone

more.text: Use Global Accelerator for non-HTTP or fast failover.

sides.head: Example
sides.text: Improve performance for a TCP/UDP game server worldwide with static IPs

more.head: Answer
more.extra: CloudFront caches HTTP, not game traffic

sides.text: Load balancing strategy
ALB for HTTP routing, NLB for extreme performance or static IPs, GWLB for appliances
Route 53 latency routing
Direct users to the Region with the lowest latency
Placement of resources
Put resources near users (Regions, Local Zones, edge), and compute near data to cut transfer time
VPC subnet tiers
Public (load balancers), private application, private data; route tables and NACLs per tier
IPv6 in VPC

Dual-stack VPCs
IPv6 addresses are public
use an egress-only internet gateway for outbound-only
Elastic Network Adapter and Elastic IPs
ENIs carry private IPs and security groups; Elastic IPs are static public IPv4 addresses
Network scaling
Plan CIDR growth, use multiple AZs, Transit Gateway for many VPCs, and enhanced networking for throughput
Amazon Kinesis Data Streams
Real-time streaming with shards; each shard ingests 1 MB/s or 1,000 records/s and reads 2 MB/s

sides.head: Example
sides.text: Ingest clickstream events in real time and process them with custom consumers
Kinesis Data Firehose
Fully managed delivery of streams to S3, Redshift, OpenSearch, and Splunk with optional Lambda transform

sides.head: Example
sides.text: Load streaming logs into S3 and Redshift with no custom consumers
Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink
Real-time analytics on streams with SQL or Flink applications
Amazon MSK
Managed Apache Kafka for existing Kafka workloads
AWS Glue

Serverless ETL and Data Catalog
crawlers discover schemas
jobs convert formats such as CSV to Parquet

sides.head: Example
sides.text: Convert CSV in S3 to Parquet on a schedule
Amazon Athena
Serverless SQL on data in S3; pay per data scanned

more.text: Columnar formats (Parquet, ORC), compression, and partitioning cut cost.

sides.head: Example
sides.text: Query log files in S3 with SQL without servers

more.head: Answer
more.extra: Convert to Parquet to reduce scanned data and cost

sides.text: AWS Lake Formation
Builds, secures, and governs data lakes on S3 with fine-grained permissions
Amazon QuickSight
Serverless BI dashboards and visualizations with SPICE in-memory engine
Amazon OpenSearch Service
Search and log analytics with dashboards
AWS DataSync
Automates online transfer between on-premises (NFS, SMB, HDFS) and S3, EFS, FSx

more.text: Up to 10 times faster than open-source tools; scheduled and verified.

sides.head: Example
sides.text: Copy 50 TB of NFS data to S3 online and keep it in sync
AWS Snow Family
Snowcone, Snowball Edge (storage or compute optimized) for offline transfer and edge compute

more.text: Use when networks are slow or transfers are huge.

sides.text: Data transfer service choice
Online and ongoing: DataSync. Continuous hybrid file access: Storage Gateway. SFTP: Transfer Family. Petabytes offline: Snow family
Ingestion patterns
Batch (S3, Glue), micro-batch, and streaming (Kinesis, MSK); choose by latency need and frequency
Data lake pattern
Land raw data in S3, catalog with Glue, query with Athena, secure with Lake Formation, visualize with QuickSight
AWS Data Exchange and Data Pipeline
Data Exchange subscribes to third-party datasets. Data Pipeline schedules data movement (legacy)
Amazon AppFlow
Transfers data between SaaS apps (Salesforce, Zendesk) and AWS services without code
